    h, w = len(grid), len(grid[0])
    # Identify the background as the color forming full separators and dominant field.

    sep_rows = [r for r,row in enumerate(grid) if all(v == bg for v in row)]
    sep_cols = [c for c in range(w) if all(grid[r][c] == bg for r in range(h))]
    # The seed is the rectangular tile immediately following the final complete separator.
    r0 = sep_rows[-1] + 1 if sep_rows else 0
    c0 = sep_cols[-1] + 1 if sep_cols else 0
    # Seed dimensions end at the next complete separators, or the grid boundary.
    r1 = next((r for r in range(r0, h) if r in sep_rows), h)
    c1 = next((c for c in range(c0, w) if c in sep_cols), w)
    seed = [row[c0:c1] for row in grid[r0:r1]]
    if not seed or not seed[0]:

    ph, pw = len(seed), len(seed[0])
    out = [row[:] for row in grid]
    for r in range(h):
        for c in range(w):
            # Keep background separator lines; repeat seed only over background cells.
            if grid[r][c] == bg:
                v = seed[(r-r0) % ph][(c-c0) % pw]
                if v != bg:
                    out[r][c] = v
    return out
